development_result: PA-NF v5 development passed every preregistered promotion gate on dataset seed 16037 and model seeds 4501-4505
confirmation_purpose: test whether the v5 development result replicates on a fresh independently generated synthetic benchmark without any architecture, objective, control, metric, threshold, sample-size, renderer, calibration, or gate changes

requirements: candidate and control parameter counts exactly equal
max operator inverse roundtrip MSE across candidate/control < 1e-8
candidate mean operator-only known-scanner transport gain > 0
candidate mean operator-only heldout-scanner transport gain > 0
candidate mean heldout biological-latent recovery R2 >= 0.80
candidate-minus-control heldout biological R2 lower 95% bootstrap bound > 0
control-minus-candidate heldout canonical alignment MSE lower 95% bootstrap bound > 0
candidate-minus-control heldout same-identity retrieval lower 95% bootstrap bound >= 0
control-minus-candidate known-scanner probe accuracy lower 95% bootstrap bound > 0

decision_rule.pass: v5 synthetic mechanism is confirmed on an untouched independently generated benchmark; stop synthetic tuning and move to a separately preregistered real paired-acquisition test
decision_rule.fail: retain the v5 development pass but record confirmation failure; do not tune on dataset seed 22037 or model seeds 4601-4605

claim_boundary: A confirmation pass supports the v5 inverse-transport factorization mechanism only within this synthetic invertible acquisition family. It does not establish real-scanner invertibility, WSI-level predictive benefit, clinical robustness, or additive group structure.

reproducibility.required_cuda_environment: CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 before Python starts when running on CUDA
